clusters.headline: Gibran Rakabuming Raka Formally Resigns As Indonesian Vice President
aiSummaryBullets: Gibran Rakabuming Raka submitted a formal five-paragraph resignation letter directly to President Prabowo Subianto at the State Palace.
Official statements confirm the letter does not specify a reason for the resignation, with officials describing the matter as personal.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Police Link Former Chief to Illegal Surveillance Case
aiSummaryBullets: Police Chief Suyudi Ario Seto accused former chief Listyo Sigit Prabowo of ordering illegal surveillance against the president.
Bareskrim investigators have conducted a search at the residence of the former police chief regarding the ongoing investigation.

clusters.headline: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka Formally Resigns From Office
aiSummaryBullets: Gibran Rakabuming Raka officially resigned as Vice President of Indonesia on November 12, 2026.
The transition follows a formal meeting with President Prabowo Subianto at the Merdeka Palace.

clusters.headline: Gibran Rakabuming Raka Officially Resigns As Vice President Of Indonesia
aiSummaryBullets: Gibran Rakabuming Raka formally submitted his resignation letter to the People's Consultative Assembly (MPR) on Thursday.
Government officials and political parties have confirmed that administrative operations remain normal despite the current vacancy in the vice presidency.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka Resigns From Office
aiSummaryBullets: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka has formally resigned from his position of his own volition.
The resignation has resulted in the immediate termination of the impeachment proceedings previously initiated in the House of Representatives.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Vice President Gibran Resigns Canceling Impeachment Vote
aiSummaryBullets: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka has officially stepped down from his office.
The Indonesian House of Representatives canceled a scheduled plenary session regarding an impeachment motion.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka Resigns From Post
aiSummaryBullets: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka stepped down following public scrutiny over his overseas education credentials.
The resignation is linked to reports that a submitted certificate failed to confirm his equivalence to a local vocational high school diploma.

clusters.headline: Gibran Rakabuming Raka Resigns From Indonesian Vice Presidency
aiSummaryBullets: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka has formally resigned from his position.
The Coordinating Minister for Law, Human Rights, Immigration, and Corrections stated the differences between impeachment and resignation.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Ministry Revokes Gibran Rakabuming Raka Diploma Status
aiSummaryBullets: The Ministry of Primary and Secondary Education has officially revoked the high school diploma equivalence certificate held by Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka.
Minister Yusril Ihza Mahendra stated the revocation follows a Supreme Court ruling regarding educational qualification requirements for the vice presidency.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Police Launch Investigation Into Alleged Treason Plot
aiSummaryBullets: The Indonesian National Police have officially commenced a criminal investigation into suspected treason.
The probe follows allegations linked to the unauthorized wiretapping of President Prabowo.
